pay_detail: $1,200. Scholarships based on financial need (free or reduced lunch or SNAP) require a $150 fee, with $100 refunded if you finish.
name: RISE: Research, Inquiry Skills and Experimentation
what_you_do: Do your own science research project in a year-long, mostly asynchronous online program. You find a mentor, write a research paper, make a poster and present at spring science symposia.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12. You must find your own research mentor and lab space if needed. IMSA cannot provide them.
deadline_text: Registration opened Thursday, July 30, 2026 at noon. Spots are limited. Refund deadlines are mid and late September 2026.
how_to_apply: Sign up online on the IMSA High School Online Programs page. Or apply for a scholarship instead. Do not pay if you apply for a scholarship. Email studentenrichment@imsa.edu.
notes: It is a hard program. Daily work is expected and you must meet firm deadlines. Failing three deadlines means removal without a refund. IJAS fair entries must be made as an IMSA RISE student for Region 5. Program is non-credit.
city: Online, run by IMSA in Aurora, IL
